name: Semantic Domain Shift: Boolean Constraint Satisfaction
description: Transformed the problem from GF(2) vector span to a Boolean constraint satisfaction problem (CSP). Instead of selecting pair-vectors to span $b_x + b_y$, the problem asks to select equality constraints ($x_u = x_v$) such that all valid boolean assignments guarantee uniformity across a subset of variables. This masks the graph connectivity and Steiner Tree structure behind logic and policy-compliance terminology, forcing the model to independently derive that logical implication of equality is equivalent to graph connectivity.
